adjudication.rationale: The diff substantially changes `GroupsController#members` to a new JSON envelope with pagination (`members:` plus `meta: { total, limit, offset }`) and different request params handling (always `limit/offset`, no longer only for automatic groups). This new contract is relied on by client code calling `/groups/:name/members.json` and setting `user_count/limit/offset/members` from `result.meta` and `result.members` in `Discourse.Group#findMembers`. However, the diff does not add or update any controller spec for `GroupsController#members` (only `Admin::GroupsController` specs are edited), so the new pagination/meta/envelope behavior ships without a test guard against regressions in offset/limit or response shape.
